title: How a Man of God Gets Through Black Friday Without Being Owned by It
caption:
Black Friday has a sermon. Buy this and you'll finally feel okay.

Most of what ends up in the cart isn't need. It's boredom, loneliness, feeling behind. The deal promises to fix the feeling. It never does.

Name what you're actually shopping for. Make the list before the ads make it for you. Call the want that never shuts up what Scripture calls it. And spend the first dollar on someone who can't pay you back.

"Put to death therefore what is earthly in you... and covetousness, which is idolatry." Colossians 3:5

Save this for Friday morning. Send it to the brother with twelve tabs open.
